desc: Implement a helper to find the period of 10^k mod d for each d in 1-9.
For each digit d from 1 to 9, initialize a count array of size d to store remainder frequencies.
Iterate through the string, and for each position j where s[j] == str(d), compute the remainder of the substring s[i..j] mod d for i from j down to max(0, j-period).
Use the precomputed count array to account for substrings starting before j-period, leveraging the periodicity of 10^k mod d.
Update the count array with the current remainder for future iterations.
Sum up all valid counts and return the result.
Implement the solution as described above.
